description: Sulut ja rantarakenteet is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto Traficom. Aineisto sisältää merikarttatuotteilla esitettävät sulut ja rantarakenteet. Coverage: Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto Traficom. The publisher named on the listing is Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto Traficom. Its keywords include avoindata.fi, Kansallinen, Ei-Inspire, Merialueet. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
